name: Golden Bell Technique (Combat)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Constitution 15, Iron Shirt, ki pool, BAB +6

Benefit(s): When in iron shirt style, a practitioner can spend 1 ki point as an immediate action to gain a +3 bonus to natural armor until the start of their next turn. This must be done before dice are rolled but after their declaration of attack.
